definitions.explanation: A written order from a doctor specifying medicine to be dispensed by a pharmacist. In Japan, prescriptions are typically taken to a separate pharmacy rather than filled at the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The doctor wrote me a prescription.

examples.japanese: {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I take the prescription to the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦なし→なし：03779_nashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some medicines cannot be bought without a prescription.

examples.japanese: {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有効期限|ゆうこうきげん}→有効期限：06415_yuukoukigen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4⟦{日間|かかん}→日間：noentry⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧ (formulation, prescription) + ⟦{箋|せん}→箋：noentry⟧ (slip, tag)

JAPANESE HEALTHCARE SYSTEM:
In Japan, clinics and hospitals usually do not dispense medicine directly. Instead, patients receive a {処方箋|しょほうせん} and take it to a nearby ⟦{調剤薬局|ちょうざいやっきょく}→調剤薬局：29876_chouzaiyakkyoku⟧ (dispensing pharmacy).

KEY TERMS:
- {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦{薬|やく}→薬：noentry⟧ - prescription medicine
- ⟦{市販薬|しはんやく}→市販薬：09834_shihanyaku⟧/OTC⟦{薬|やく}→薬：noentry⟧ - over-the-counter medicine
- ⟦{調剤薬局|ちょうざいやっきょく}→調剤薬局：29876_chouzaiyakkyoku⟧ - dispensing pharmacy
- ⟦{院内処方|いんないしょほう}→院内処方：29877_innaishohou⟧ - in-hospital dispensing
- ⟦{院外処方|いんがいしょほう}→院外処方：29878_ingaishohou⟧ - out-of-hospital dispensing

VALIDITY: Prescriptions in Japan expire after 4 days (including the day of issue), so they must be filled promptly.

COMMON VERBS:
- {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ - to write a prescription
- {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ - to issue a prescription
- {処方箋|しょほうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧ - to take a prescription (to the pharmacy)
